# Cross-Model × Cross-Population Teacher-Forced CE

Positive gain is M4 CE minus M5 CE. Own-population fitting uses model_arm=dataset_arm; off-diagonal entries are cross-population transfer. Both populations were used for their corresponding training and may share instances, so this is not an unseen-generalization test.
